name: MySampark
author: mysamparkapp

sections.description:
MySampark links this site to your MySampark account in a couple of clicks:

  • Installs the MySampark AI chat widget on every page automatically.
  • Links your WooCommerce product catalog, if this is a WooCommerce store.
  • No API keys, script tags, or code editing required — the plugin handles the connection for you.

This plugin requires a free MySampark account. If you don’t have one yet, you can create one during the connect step at mysampark.com.

How it works

  1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Go to MySampark in the wp-admin sidebar and click Connect to MySampark.
  3. Approve the connection on your MySampark dashboard.
  4. You’re redirected back here, connected — the chat widget starts showing on your site automatically. If this is a WooCommerce store, click Connect this WooCommerce store to link your product catalog too.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mysampark-connect folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the Plugins → Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to MySampark in the admin menu and follow the connect flow.
sections.faq:
Do I need a MySampark account?

Yes. This plugin only connects an existing (or newly created) MySampark account to this WordPress site — it doesn’t work standalone.

Does this modify my theme files?

No. The chat widget is added via the standard wp_footer hook; nothing is written to your theme.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The chat widget stops appearing on your site immediately. Your MySampark account and any WooCommerce data already synced are unaffected — reactivating and reconnecting restores it.

How do I fully disconnect?

Use the “Disconnect this site” button on the MySampark settings page, then also remove the connection from your MySampark account’s connected-apps settings.
